name: ICWF World Title
epitaph: Declared the federation's top prize in its own January 2006 Revised Information Packet, required to be defended at least once a month; no reign was ever recorded against it.

name: ICWF Television Title
epitaph: Pitched in the federation's own January 2006 Revised Information Packet as a stepping stone toward the World Title, defended weekly; no reign was ever recorded against it.

name: ICWF Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Announced in the federation's own January 2006 Revised Information Packet to be awarded through a "Spin the Wheel" deathmatch tournament and defended every two to three weeks; no reign was ever recorded against it.

name: ICWF World Tag-Team Titles
epitaph: Named in the federation's own January 2006 Revised Information Packet as its tag-team championship, required to be defended once a month; no reign was ever recorded against it.
